## Where This Lives in UpstreamDrift {#sec-upstream-implementation-pog-ch28}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The scalar impact illustration in this chapter is analytic. UpstreamDrift's shared impact helpers used in swing replay and equipment studies are pinned at commit [`27b6eead`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/commit/27b6eeadbbd970bebb8926a3c83aeaea1f6ee4da).

- **Impact physics utilities:** [`_impact_physics.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/27b6eeadbbd970bebb8926a3c83aeaea1f6ee4da/src/shared/python/physics/_impact_physics.py) — restitution and impulse helpers referenced across engine replay tooling.

**Convention note:** multi-contact impact in production models still requires the coupled complementarity or engine-specific contact solver documented for that run; this module does not replace those solves.
:::
